bandReport.notes: Band covers items 1-20, NOT the estimated 1-25. This booklet prints exactly 4 items per page (2 per column), so 5 pages = 20 items; the pages are the truth. Item 1 opens at the top of p01-c1 (booklet page 3) and item 20 ends with its four options plus '[ P.T.O.' at the foot of p05-c2, so nothing spills past either band edge. All ten column crops are clean: every item sits wholly inside one column, no item number is missing from the top of a c2 crop, and no line is sliced down the middle. Nothing spans the gutter on any of the five pages (verified against p04.png as a structure check). p04 has a heavy black scan border along its top and left edges and the page number '9' is clipped at the right edge of p04-c1, but no question text is affected. Faint Hindi show-through from the reverse of each leaf is visible on every page; it is bleed-through, not content. No defective questions, no duplicate option texts, and the numbering runs 1..20 with no skips.
